name: Telescope
text: A brass spyglass that brings the far horizon near.

name: Scales
text: A merchant's balance with a pair of brass pans.

name: Globe
text: A painted globe of Nirn on a turning stand.

name: Skeleton
text: A complete human skeleton, wired together for study.

name: Soul Trap
text: A gem prepared to catch and hold a departing soul.

name: Totem
text: A carved totem bearing the marks of an old spirit.

name: Dead Body
text: A corpse. Someone, somewhere, will want to know about it.

name: Mantella
text: The Mantella: a gem of impossible power, sought by kings and gods alike.

name: Finger
text: A severed finger. Its owner will not be needing it.

name: Portal Stone
text: A stone attuned to a portal, humming faintly when held.

name: Welkynd Stone
text: An Ayleid welkynd stone, full of captured starlight.

name: Varla Stone
text: A varla stone, an Ayleid relic brimming with magicka.

name: Weir Key
text: A heavy key cut for the gates of the Weir.

name: Starfall Glass
text: Glass fused where a star fell, still warm in the palm.

name: Trophy
text: A hunter's trophy taken from a notable kill.

name: Keepsake
text: A small keepsake that meant something to someone.

name: Remains
text: What is left of a fallen adventurer.
